caseName: S. S. Silberblatt, Inc. v. Tax Commission
caseNameFull: S. S. SILBERBLATT, INC. v. TAX COMMISSION OF NEW YORK

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the. Court of Appeals of New York. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief setting forth his views as to the importance to the Federal Government of the issues involved.
